_about: Every word the page shows outside the hints. The page fills elements marked data-copy from the keys here; the core fills each {placeholder}.
title: Backbeat Pizza
tagline: Bake pizzas for a band of picky drummers. Work out each secret order from their riffs and hints.
how: Each drummer wants one secret pizza.
Build a pizza at the counter, then serve it to a drummer. A Maskling carries it over.
The drummer plays a riff and drops a hint. ★ Perfect: that's the order. ▲ Close: nothing on it is wrong, but something is missing. ✕ Miss: something on it is wrong.
The whole band shares one patience. Every pizza served uses one. Crack every order before it runs out.
You can serve another drummer while one is still tasting.
layers_some: Pick one of each: {layers}. Then any toppings.
toppings_rule: {count} toppings on the menu. Each order has {min} to {max} of them.
clarity_named: Hints count the wrong things and name one of them, or count the missing toppings.
clarity_counted: Hints count the wrong things, or count the missing toppings.
clarity_vague: Hints say only perfect, close or miss.
patience_rule: The band will taste {count} pizzas in all.
won_text: Every drummer got the perfect pie, with {count} patience to spare.
lost_text: Patience ran out with {count} orders still open. Try again, and the drummers will want new pizzas.
finale_text: Every level cleared. The band says your kitchen is the best on tour.
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, so the stage cannot be drawn. The kitchen still works.
